literal_meaning: পদের অর্পণ বা পদস্থাপন (foot placement or offering of feet)
figurative_meaning_en: Presence infused with reverence or honor
example_sentences_in_bangla: সাধুর পদার্পণ এই স্থানকে পবিত্র করে তুলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: We are honored by your presence.
The saint's visit has sanctified this place.
note: Often used in contexts of welcoming esteemed guests or spiritual figures in Bengali tradition.
